position.identity: Benson S. Hsu, MD, MBA. Pediatric intensivist and former health system executive. I build with AI, run the data, and decide what's worth it.
position.promise: I help health systems, investors and companies decide which clinical AI to trust, invest in and build on, and how to get it adopted and grow it safely.
position.proof: Every decision is backed by a lab: builds with current models, dated, with the results reported, including what broke, and a verdict on each.
position.method: Four stages: Strategy, Build or buy, Rules, Proof. Every entry and every memo ends in a verdict: Build, Buy, Skip or Wait.

signature_block.name: Benson S. Hsu, MD, MBA
signature_block.line: Pediatric intensivist. Former health system executive.

stages.name: Strategy
stages.question: Is it worth doing, worth investing in, and what will it cost, save or earn?

stages.name: Build or buy
stages.question: Build it, buy it, partner, or wait? Is the vendor's claim real? What should we innovate around?

stages.name: Rules
stages.question: How do we approve, govern, and keep it safe as it grows?

stages.name: Proof
stages.question: Is it working at our site, for our patients, and is it still true with this year's models?

pivot_story: I built five clinical AI tools in a year.
I tested whether any had a moat, and none did.
I learned the hard part is deciding what's safe and worth it, and proving it.
This site is how I do that, for my own tools and for yours.

doors.line: A decision memo that ends in Build, Buy, Skip or Wait, with the governance requirements attached.
A diligence read that says whether the clinical AI is real, safe and defensible, in five to ten business days.
The clinical half of an engagement: the four-stage method, by the day or by the project.

offers.name: Red-flag read
offers.scope: One tool or one company, deal-breakers only, one-page verdict
offers.note: Credited against a tier 2 read on the same target within 90 days

offers.name: Decision memo or diligence read
offers.scope: Full four-stage memo, verdict, cost and governance requirements, one revision round, questions included

offers.name: Multi-vendor or portfolio read
offers.scope: Up to three tools or companies against one thesis

offers.name: Clinical AI expert on a project
offers.scope: Clinical judgment on a client engagement, by the day or by the project

fee_line: Fixed fee, quoted in writing before work starts. No hourly billing inside an engagement; questions are included.
engagement_steps: The memo, and one revision round.

rules.seat: On any one company I sit on one side only: the fund's or the company's, never both.
rules.sells: The practice sells decisions, not software.

disclosure: Tools were built on my own time with no institutional data. Advisory work is disclosed to my employer.
